# HCI Swiss

Official public commercial information for HCI Swiss, operated under FK HERMES INTERNATIONAL.

Canonical landing page: https://fkhermes23-byte.github.io/HCISWISS.com/
Official website: https://www.hciswiss.com
Machine-readable offer catalog: https://fkhermes23-byte.github.io/HCISWISS.com/catalog.json

## Scope

HCI Swiss supports non-clinical digital operations and documentation workflows for care-service organisations and independent professionals.

## Recurring-only commercial model

Commercial model: recurring_only
Public checkout: disabled
GitHub Sponsors: inactive
Qualification: required for every offer
Supported billing periods: month or year

## Canonical recurring offers

- `careops-readiness-retainer` — PRE — CareOps readiness retainer (`recurring_service`, `pre_deal`)
- `managed-implementation-operations` — DURING — Managed implementation and operations (`recurring_service`, `during_deal`)
- `continuity-monitoring-renewal` — POST — Continuity, monitoring and renewal (`recurring_service`, `post_deal`)
- `recurring-partnership-licensing` — Recurring partnership and licensing (`recurring_business_relationship`, `cross_lifecycle`)

Every listed offer is recurring, requires qualification and an expressly accepted payment mandate, supports an operational cancellation path, prohibits one-time checkout and requires new informed acceptance after a material change.

## Commercial boundary

No public payment route is provided. Availability, contracting entity, service scope, price, currency, billing frequency, renewal, cancellation, revocation, data obligations and acceptance criteria must be confirmed in versioned written terms. Material changes require new informed acceptance. Repository presence is not evidence of payment, delivery, regulatory clearance or CASH_RECONCILED.

Public information is not proof of availability in every geography, regulatory approval, a contract or a guaranteed outcome.
